function: MU-MIMO downlink beamforming under probabilistic SINR constraints by a GPU-parallel ZF-cone sampling and scaling search; excluded as no_learning: no trained component, unlike learning-based solutions (pp. 2, 6).
notes: Exclude, reason no_learning. ReDBeam is a parallel optimization algorithm, p. 6: "it generates a sufficiently large number (denoted as L) of initial solutions within a promising search space ... we employ a scaling-based local search". Its 'data-driven' label means an empirical Wasserstein ambiguity set built from N noisy CSI samples (p. 5), and pp. 1-2 contrast the approach with learning: "unlike learning-based solutions, D2BF only requires limited CSI data samples collected in real-time and does not need a complicated offline training process". No neural network or trained parameters; N, L and rho are set by sweeps (pp. 11-12). Earlier checks pass: research article, MU-MIMO with M = 6-20 BS antennas, results on pp. 11-15.
